frequency_question: How often do executive principals follow through to deliver a finalized major regulatory rule within a tight mandatory window when directed?
membership_rule: Includes instances where a central government executive branch or ministry was given a direct judicial or supreme mandate with a hard deadline to finalize a major public health or consumer standard. Excludes routine bureaucratic rulemakings without high-level judicial compulsion.

cases.name: Mandatory Bureau of Energy Efficiency star rating rules enforcement (India, 2018)
FSSAI timeline compliance for nutraceutical regulations finalization (India, 2021)
Supreme Court-mandated phased rollout of BS-VI emission norms notification (India, 2020)
MoEFCC notification on plastic waste management strict amendment timelines (India, 2022)
Ayushman Bharat digital health framework final standard notification under court nudge (India, 2023)
DGCA safety regulation overhaul under high court directive (India, 2019)

coverage_note: 6 named prominent regulatory compliance events under judicial/executive pressure; believed representative of the broader class.
known_gaps: Does not exhaustively list every minor administrative delay across all state departments, focusing primarily on Union-level health, environmental, and safety mandates.
validity_reason: Executive compliance patterns and responsiveness to judicial timelines remain stable across the current political administration's tenure.
